question: What transition is made after completing the description of the archway?
premises: The archway has been described in the preceding verses.
The text now turns to the eight auspicious things.
The eight auspicious things are stated next.
inference: Having thus described the archway, the text proceeds to state the eight auspicious things.
plain_english: Thus the archway has been described; now the eight auspicious things are stated.
